data.title: Claims: per-agent actor and an honest claim response
data.description: B1 + B3. The actor is git user.email, so every agent one developer runs is one claimant: 10 concurrent claims all got KAD-1 with contestedBy: [], and nothing reports it after merge (reproduced 2026-09-18). Add KADENCE_ACTOR (fallback: git email). Under a race the response is built from the state before the write: 5 of 8 agents were told they held a task they had lost. Re-read state after the write and return status: claimed | already_yours | contested. Touches the --json contract, so it must be additive. Evidence: docs/research/contract-stress-audit-2026-09.md §2
